asked.item: Do I need to pick something else after selecting the Facebook account?

verdict.reason: The pages say a Facebook destination also needs a Facebook Page chosen in Options, and that Pick a time needs a date and time before submitting.

steps.text: Yes, after you select the destination account, complete its destination selector in Options, which for Facebook is a Facebook Page.
Select the Facebook Page for this post.
If you are using Pick a time, select a date and time before submitting.
